checks.name: the minimal image (with this guest agent), the host daemon and its signature are built
two sandboxes boot from APFS clones that allocate under 50 MB at creation
each has its own /etc/machine-id and MAC, and its hostname is its name
a file written in one is absent in the other
resize to 3 CPUs restarts the sandbox, reports what ended, and nproc says 3
rename gives the running guest its new hostname at once
SIGTERM hibernates both; the restart wakes them with the same background PID
delete stops each sandbox and removes its directory
